title: Guess My Number
body:
Goal: a guessing game built from two while loops: a game loop and an input-checking loop.

  1. Open starter.py and press Run. Guess the number... It never stops, even when you are right! Press the red Stop button. That is an infinite loop - this week's bug.
  2. TODO 1: add 1 to tries every time round the loop.
  3. TODO 3: break out of the loop when the result is "Correct".
  4. TODO 2: now type banana as a guess - crash! Make ask_number() keep asking until the answer is a whole number from low to high. answer.isdigit() is True only when the answer is made of digits.

Done looks like:

I am thinking of a number from 1 to 20...
Guess a number from 1 to 20: banana
Oops! Please type a whole number from 1 to 20.
Guess a number from 1 to 20: 10
Too low
Guess a number from 1 to 20: 15
Correct
You got it in 2 tries!

Extra: give the player only 5 tries. Can you make it fair, so a smart player can always win? (Hint: always guess the middle!)

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Read the three TODO comments in starter.py. Two of them are inside play(), and one is inside ask_number(). Fix them one at a time and run after each fix. If the game never stops, press the red Stop button.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: A while loop only stops if something inside it changes, or if you use break. To count, make a number bigger each round. To leave the loop early, use break inside an if.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: In play(), use tries = ____ + ____ and then if result == ____: with break below it. In ask_number(), wrap the code in while True:. Only return when answer.isdigit() is True and the number fits between low and high.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Guess My Number
# check_guess() is done. Finish the two while loops.

import random


def check_guess(guess, secret):
    """Return "Too low", "Too high" or "Correct"."""
    if guess < secret:
        return "Too low"
    elif guess > secret:
        return "Too high"
    else:
        return "Correct"


def ask_number(low, high):
    """Keep asking until the player types a whole number from low to high, then return it."""
    # TODO 2: typing "banana" crashes the game! Put this in a  while True:  loop.
    # Only return the number if answer.isdigit() is True AND it is from low to high.
    # Otherwise print a friendly "Please type a whole number..." message.
    answer = input(f"Guess a number from {low} to {high}: ")
    return int(answer)


def play(secret, low=1, high=20):
    """Play one game. Return how many guesses it took."""
    tries = 0
    while True:
        guess = ask_number(low, high)
        # TODO 1: add 1 to tries here.
        result = check_guess(guess, secret)
        print(result)
        # TODO 3: if result is "Correct", break out of the loop.
        #         (Until you do, the game never ends! Press the red Stop button.)
    print(f"You got it in {tries} tries!")
    return tries


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("I am thinking of a number from 1 to 20...")
    secret = random.randint(1, 20)
    play(secret)
